# billsschedule2026.online — Buffalo Bills Schedule 2026

An unofficial fan broadcast & streaming guide for the Buffalo Bills 2026 NFL season.
Covers every game's kickoff time (Eastern Time), TV network (CBS, FOX, NBC, ESPN, Amazon Prime Video), streaming options, radio (WGR 550 AM), printable PDF schedule, and calendar sync.

## Pages

- / — Buffalo Bills Schedule 2026: Official game times, TV channels, streaming & Week 12 bye week guide (17 regular-season games, primetime breakdown, Highmark Stadium weather, AFC East rivalries, depth chart, ticket & calendar sync).
- /where-to-watch — What channel is the Buffalo Bills game on today: CBS/FOX/NBC/ESPN/Prime Video, 506 Sports coverage maps, Paramount+/Peacock/ESPN+/Prime, NFL Sunday Ticket on YouTube TV, cord-cutting (Fubo/Hulu/Sling), WGR 550 radio, DAZN NFL Game Pass internationally, OTA antenna & Bills Backers bars.
- /preseason-schedule — 2026 Buffalo Bills preseason schedule: August dates, kickoff times (ET), WIVB-TV Channel 4, roster battles, Josh Allen playing time, St. John Fisher training camp, NFL+ streaming.
- /printable-schedule — Free printable 2026 Bills schedule PDF (8.5x11 & wallet), color-coded home/away, 4-time-zone conversion, Google/Apple calendar (.ics) sync, office-pool grid.

## Notes

Not affiliated with the NFL or the Buffalo Bills. All times Eastern (ET). Broadcast rights per the current NFL media deal (through 2033).
